subject: Supplier kickstart: procurement checklist, DPA & subprocessor list
messages:
From: Sahil Gupta <sahil@cloudnova.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudnova.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier — privacy & billing details needed

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking our intake form — we are trying to finish the vendor setup so we can issue a PO and move to contract signature. Procurement needs the following from Redwood before we can create the PO:

- Fully executed DPA (or signed DPA request if you need countersignature)
- Link to your latest SOC 2 report (or a portal link to view)
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Billing remit-to address and W-9 (for US vendors)

Can you send those by EOD tomorrow? Also let me know your standard payment terms (Net30/Net45) and the invoice email to route to our AP team.

Sahil
Sahil Gupta
Senior Procurement Manager — CloudNova
sahil@cloudnova.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
To: Sahil Gupta <sahil@cloudnova.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — privacy & billing details needed

Hi Sahil — thanks, looping in our procurement lead and billing ops. Quick answers first, details below:

- Payment terms: Net30 by default (we can accommodate Net45 on enterprise contracts)
- Invoice remit-to: invoices@redwood-inference.com (cc billing@redwood-inference.com)
- W-9: attached (we provide a PDF when requested)

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.2_signed-request.pdf (we are asking CloudNova to sign the DPA); subprocessors-list-2027-07.csv; SOC2-report-Redwood-2027-Q1.html (link in email also provided)

Full checklist & next steps below — Laura / Ben, can one of you create the Coupa PO-ready packet and confirm GL code for the services line? We expect initial monthly invoice to reference deal CN-2027-5321.

---
Vendor kickstart packet (what we supplied):
1) Draft DPA (DocuSign link) — https://app.docusign.com/document/ABC123-Redwood-DPA (please sign, or we can countersign)
2) SOC 2 report (read-only portal) — https://s3.redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2/2027-q1/index.html
3) Subprocessor roster (CSV) — attached
4) W-9 and billing instructions — attached to this thread
5) PO guidance: Redwood prefers invoices to include deal id in subject and be sent to invoices@redwood-inference.com. Standard remittance: Redwood Inc., 120 Market St, Suite 205, San Francisco, CA 94103

Next actions for CloudNova: confirm you can sign the DPA via DocuSign or return a redline; confirm AP contact and required PO fields; let us know if you require a supplier request in Coupa and we'll submit.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
To: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — privacy & billing details needed

Thanks Mateo — I will prepare the PO-ready packet and route to Coupa. Quick checklist for my side:
- Confirm GL code for product usage: 50210 (SaaS subscriptions)
- Confirm contract owner for invoice approvals: Mateo Alvarez (will approve first two invoices)
- Attach signed DPA when CloudNova returns it

Ben — can you verify that the attached subprocessors CSV matches our current disclosure? If any of the subs are missing we need to update the compliance portal before we route to procurement.

I'll draft the supplier entry and include the remit address and invoices@redwood-inference.com. ETA to have the Coupa entry created: end of day tomorrow (Fri, 6 Aug).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Ops — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com

From: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — privacy & billing details needed

Laura — quick check done. The subprocessors-list-2027-07.csv looks current except we need to add FastCache Inc. (they were added to infra in June). I attached a one-line update to the CSV (see attachment note).

Also: procurement wants to see whether CloudNova requires data-residency guarantees — Sahil, can you confirm whether CloudNova will store any customer-provided data in another region? If yes, we'll flag for our security team. Otherwise the standard DPA covers the processing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Purchasing — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood-inference.com

From: Sahil Gupta <sahil@cloudnova.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudnova.com
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier — privacy & billing details needed

Mateo — thanks for the packet and quick turnaround. A few clarifications:

> Can you send those by EOD tomorrow?

We reviewed the materials and have the following:
- We can sign your DPA via DocuSign — please set the envelope to sahil@cloudnova.com and accounts-payable@cloudnova.com
- SOC 2 link is fine. Procurement will not store a copy locally, thanks for the portal link.
- Subprocessor list accepted after you add FastCache Inc. — Ben, thanks for flagging.
- AP confirms remit-to as invoices@redwood-inference.com; please include Redwood's Tax ID on the W-9 PDF.

Next steps from our side: we will initiate the PO in our Coupa instance once the DPA is fully executed and we have the vendor-supplier ID. I will also confirm whether CloudNova will route any customer data to non-US regions by Tuesday.

Sahil
